ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the given food web, which organism will lose its source of energy if there were no phytoplanktons?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, Phytoplankton (phytoplankton) is marked in the lower left corner, and Krill (krill) is located near above it. There is an arrow in the diagram from Phytoplankton to Krill, indicating that krill directly obtain energy from phytoplankton. Reasoning: The question asks which organism would lose its energy source if there were no phytoplankton. Since the diagram shows that Krill directly uses Phytoplankton as an energy source, the one that would lose its energy source when there is no phytoplankton is krill.
